sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
'''Kyroptero: Stone Guardian''' possesses the '''Lazy''' power which means that he cannot move on his own, but that effect is no problem with cards like [[TCG:SAS-110|Hyperstride]]. He is one of the stronger [[Titans]] around and is not one to shy away from a fight.
